summary: TASK-AR-587 aligns the agent avatar pattern to a locally vendored DiceBear Identicon CC0 style boundary, keeps runtime SVG output token-driven, preserves deterministic role accents, and verifies agent-card placement on desktop and mobile.
implemented: Vendored @dicebear/identicon 9.4.2 package metadata, LICENSE, schema, row components, and style helpers under src/agent_runtime/vendor/dicebear/identicon/9.4.2.
Updated patternAgentAvatar to expose data-dicebear-style="identicon" and data-dicebear-version="9.4.2".
Changed the Python and JavaScript avatar generators to use the DiceBear Identicon row pattern schema boundary with the existing token palette instead of the upstream hex palette.
Kept deterministic role accent rings mapped to semantic tokens and added WCAG AA non-text contrast coverage for light and dark surfaces.
Kept the avatar rendered in console agent cards and verified desktop/mobile DOM rendering.

license_and_asset_boundary.name: @dicebear/identicon
license_and_asset_boundary.runtime_boundary: No runtime HTTP API dependency; the console uses local row schema constants mirrored from the vendored package and token-safe SVG rendering.
